scientific_integrity: Originality is restricted to a bivariate cycle-specific pointwise-minimal function census. The 1992 Fielder numerical sequence, 2022 C5 total, and standard minimum-weight bound are explicitly acknowledged as preexisting. The formulas are proved for labelled simple cycles; a published equivalent bivariate formula may still exist. Verification is finite and there is no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only simple labelled cycles n>=3 and pointwise-minimal Roman dominating functions.
The univariate total sequence and lowest-weight results are prior-known independently.
2021 primary PDF image access 403; indexed text was examined.
Publication priority and independent mathematical validation are not certified.
title: Exact weight census of pointwise-minimal Roman domination on cycles
